verdict.rationale: Raygun's own export feature acts on many items at once: it can export all error groups or a selected set from the Crash Reporting dashboard, and CSV exports respect applied filters. That is a real but narrow bulk operation. Error status changes (Resolved, Ignore with conditions) are documented only per error group, and nothing shows the MCP server or an API doing bulk actions. Missing for 10: bulk status changes (resolve/ignore/assign many error groups at once), programmatic or agent-driven bulk operations via API or MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
